title.value: Towards assessing agricultural land suitability with causal machine learning
title.justification: The title succinctly captures the essence of the research, focusing on utilizing causal machine learning to evaluate agricultural land suitability.
title.quote: Towards assessing agricultural land suitability with causal machine learning

extractions.description: This paper focuses on employing causal machine learning to assess the suitability of agricultural land for various management practices such as crop rotation and landscape crop diversity, especially in the context of climate change adaptation. The study uses historical agricultural and climate data from Flanders, Belgium, to evaluate the heterogeneous effects of these practices on Net Primary Productivity (NPP), an indicator of climate regulation. The findings aim to support spatially targeted agricultural policies to enhance ecosystem resilience.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is to improve agricultural practices to meet global food demands while enhancing ecosystem resilience and addressing climate change adaptation.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Understanding the suitability of agricultural land for applying specific management practices is of great importance for sustainable and resilient agriculture against climate change.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus is on adapting agricultural practices to be more suitable and resilient in the face of climate change.
primary_category.quote: We formulate this as a causal machine learning task and discuss how this approach can be used for agricultural planning in a changing climate.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper also addresses the potential for agricultural practices to contribute to climate change mitigation through improved ecosystem services and NPP.
secondary_categories.quote: Evaluating such practices by their impact on agroecosystem productivity enables implementing resilient farming systems in the light of climate change.

secondary_categories.justification: The study also involves understanding climate impacts on agriculture through data-driven climate model assessments and earth observations.
secondary_categories.quote: We used earth observations (MODIS), climate data (TerraClimate) and openly available yearly crop type maps covering North Belgium (Flanders) from 2010 to 2020.

primary_sub_category.justification: The research aims at ensuring food security by optimizing agricultural land use through climate-adaptive practices.
primary_sub_category.quote: Understanding agricultural land suitability is critical for policy applications aiming to foster sustainable agricultural practices and ensure food security.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The geographical differentiation of agricultural practices based on climate risk evaluation is discussed, aligning with climate risk modeling.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: To uncover the diverse environmental conditions that support or inhibit climate regulation we used a series of parameters provided by Terraclimate.

applications.value: Causal machine learning for optimizing agricultural land use
applications.justification: The introduction of causal machine learning to determine the effectiveness of agricultural practices in improving land suitability is a key application discussed in the paper.
applications.quote: We introduce an extensible data-driven framework that leverages earth observations and frames agricultural land suitability as a geospatial impact assessment problem.

applications.value: Use of crop rotation and landscape crop diversity for enhancing Net Primary Productivity (NPP)
applications.justification: These practices are explored in depth to understand their impact on improving agroecosystem productivity and climate regulation.
applications.quote: Specifically, we extract the agricultural management practices of 'crop rotation' and 'landscape crop diversity' from crop type maps, account for climate and land use data...

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories sufficiently cover the themes discussed in the paper.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The existing sub-categories sufficiently cover the themes discussed in the paper.
